verdict.rationale: Pinecone's 'Assistant' (pinecone-docs-2, pinecone-docs-3) is a product feature for building question-answering assistants over your own data, not an in-product AI helper you delegate tasks to. Agentic control of indexes comes from external agents through the MCP server or a Claude plugin (pinecone-docs-15, pinecone-docs-26). Those are adjacent features that rely on outside agents, so there is no evidence of a built-in assistant in the console that carries out delegated tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
